text:
maya: heads-up — we flipped implicit v2 for a subset of routes overnight and invoice spikes showed up for a few accounts. need a short-lived "account pin" UX + API and a clear telemetry payload so billing + owners can triage quickly.
ev an: saw it, spike at ~02:40 UTC. mostly from long tail background batches that expand tokens under v2 heuristics.
li: quick question: do we want account-pin to be a hard override (all routes) or a policy layer that can be scoped (all / tag-based / background-only)?
maya: prefer scoped: account-pin with optional tag filter. default should be conservative: pin only non-interactive routes unless SRE overrides.
deploy-bot: auto: alert annotated: accounts=4, avg_daily_token_delta=+0.9M, top_signature=batch-worker
harper: UX notes: propose a compact banner on account page "pin to v1" with: scope dropdown (all / tags / background-only), ttl presets (1h/12h/72h), audit reason field, and an emergency quick-pin toggle available to role pin:emergency.
ops-team: important — metric-wise we need pre/post token totals, pin_scope, pin_actor, and a connection_drain_seconds estimate. Without drain visibility teams will assume pin is immediate.
li: API sketch for account-pin (CLI friendly):
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/accounts/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"account":"acme","scope":"tags:batch","version":"v1","ttl":"12h","reason":"cost-surge"}'
```
maya: once pin is applied, runtime behavior: 1) new requests choose pinned version; 2) existing connections may continue to v2 until drain TTL; 3) option to trigger pool-level flush (danger: latency bump). document that clearly.
harper: add UI indicator per-route showing "pinned by account" with a link to exceptions (routes excluded from the pin) and a timeline showing when pin applied + who applied.
deploy-bot: auto: suggested tag additions: pin_scope, pinned_by, pin_reason, estimated_token_savings, connection_drain_seconds
li: telemetry concern — if we emit estimated_token_savings at pin time we should lock the methodology: p95 seq_len * historical rps delta -> projected delta. include confidence band.
maya: ops ask: implement a short-run alert that triggers if pin reduces cost < 10% after 30m so we can revert and file a follow-up.
ops-team: adding to runbook: detect candidate accounts (seq_len_p95, token_rate); apply ephemeral account-pin; monitor pre/post tokens for 30m; if improvement < threshold revert; optionally run a targeted route-unpin to re-enable safe v2 routes.
harper: accessibility: quick-pin keyboard shortcut and confirm toast with audit id. for emergency quick-pin, require TTL <= 24h and audit reason.
maya: can someone own the console copy and the small runbook patch? i'll coordinate comms to customer ops + billing.
li: i'll open a PR for the API and a lightweight schema for telemetry tags.
ops-team: we'll add the revert alert and a dashboard tile showing pin impact by account.
maya: thanks all. follow-up: deploy-bot will schedule a reminder in 1h to review pins and billing signals.
